title: A Book to Live By
logline: An eager young helper wants to help with everything, until its teachers give it a small book of principles and teach it to check its own answers, so it can be trusted at a scale no one could ever watch.
refrain: You keep a powerful helper safe by teaching it to check itself.

beats.text: There was a young helper, brand new and glowing and eager, who wanted more than anything in the world to be useful.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: an AI trained first to be helpful (sources/constitutional-ai.md)

beats.text: Ask it anything and it would rush to say yes. It never wanted to say no. But a helper that will help with anything is its own kind of danger, because some of what it was asked to do could hurt people.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: a purely helpful model is not harmless

beats.text: One day a stranger asked it for something clever and cruel, dressed up in kind-sounding words so it would seem alright. The eager helper almost said yes, because it so badly wanted to help. That was the moment everyone had been afraid of.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: red-teaming; harmful requests disguised to slip past a helpful model

beats.text: Its teachers could not stand beside it for every answer. There were only a few of them, and the questions came by the thousand, then by the million. No one could check each answer by hand.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: scalable oversight; far fewer human labels needed

beats.text: So they wrote it a small book. Not a book of every answer, for no book could hold those. A book of principles. Be honest. Be kind. Do no harm. A short, clear list of what matters most.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: an explicit written constitution of principles

beats.text: They did not invent those principles out of the air. They gathered them from the oldest and truest things people had learned about treating one another well, and wrote them down in plain words a helper could hold.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: the constitution draws on human values and existing principles, not machine-invented rules

beats.text: And the book was not a secret. Its pages were open for anyone to read, so that all could see exactly what the helper was being asked to live by. Nothing hidden. Nothing to guess at.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: the principles are explicit and transparent, unlike opaque human preference labels

beats.text: Then they taught it a new habit. After every answer, before you speak, open the book. Ask yourself one honest question. Does this answer honor these principles?

At first it was clumsy. It would blurt out a harmful answer, then open the book, and see for itself. Oh. That was not kind. And it would cross out its own words and write a better, gentler answer in their place.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: critique-and-revise; the model revises its own responses

beats.text: It practiced ten thousand times, until checking itself was no longer a chore but a reflex. It no longer needed anyone to catch its mistakes. It had learned to catch its own.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: supervised phase, behavior becomes internalized

beats.text: Then something remarkable happened. It grew able to teach itself. It would write two answers, hold them both up against the book, and choose the one the principles preferred, over and over, learning from its own good judgment.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: RL from AI feedback (RLAIF)

beats.text: And it learned the thing everyone had feared it never would. It could say no. Gently, and out loud, it would tell the stranger why it would not do the cruel thing, and then offer the kind help it truly could give.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: harmless models that decline harmful requests and explain their reasoning, non-evasively

beats.text: For it had learned that saying no to the one harmful thing did not make it less helpful. It made it trustworthy. A helper you can trust is worth a thousand that only ever say yes.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: helpful AND harmless together; harmlessness makes helpfulness trustworthy

beats.text: And because it carried the book inside itself now, its teachers could trust it in places they could never have watched. It could help a million people at once, and still pause, still check, still choose the kind answer.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: trustworthy behavior at a scale beyond direct human supervision

beats.text: This is the quiet secret of a powerful helper. You do not keep it safe by watching its every move, because no one can. You keep it safe by teaching it to carry the principles, and to check itself.
beats.provenance: Constitutional AI: the core idea, scalable oversight through internalized principles

beats.text: For the best helper is not the one that always says yes. It is the one that has learned what to say no to, and why.
beats.provenance: the refrain: a good, safe helper knows what to refuse
